name: How do I choose the best garage trim material for the Bay Area climate?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the best garage trim material for the Bay Area climate?

acceptedAnswer.text: For the Bay Area's varied climate, which can include fog, occasional rain, and coastal humidity, durable and moisture-resistant materials are often preferred. PVC and fiber cement are excellent choices due to their resistance to rot, mold, and insects, requiring minimal maintenance. While wood can be used, it needs regular painting or sealing to withstand the elements. Consider your home's style and your maintenance preference when making your selection.
